screen.spacebod_observer.offer.title: The Observer's Printing Press
screen.spacebod_observer.offer.body:
The Observer can write its stories with a small AI model that runs on this computer. It works offline, only ever reads what happened in this world, and writes about once a week in the background. Without it, the paper is still printed from the house templates.

Recommended for this computer: %s (%s download). You can also put any .gguf chat model in the observer-models folder yourself.
